b.x: This is a lesson, not a diploma. It does not replace a course with a manikin and an instructor, or the ambulance. In Brazil: 192 medical, 193 fire, 190 police. The red tab First aid for the prepared gray man is the quick lookup. This one is for studying before. Outside Brazil, the numbers are different.

01 The order the whole lesson repeats First the scene. Wire, fire, traffic, water, an attack, gas. If you go in and fall, now there are two. Then the voice: touch the shoulder, ask the name. Someone who answers and breathes has already told you half. Someone who does not answer, look at the chest. If it does not rise, compressions and 192. If it rises and they do not wake, on the side. Blood that soaks comes before a bone and before a scream. Call early. Say the place, what you see, whether they breathe. Do not hang up until they say so. Do not give water, food, or someone else’s medicine.

02 Someone who breathes and does not wake If the chest rises and the person does not speak, the danger is the tongue and the vomit closing the air. Lay them on the side, mouth down, the upper hand holding the face, the upper knee bent so they do not roll onto the belly. That is the recovery position. It is not comfort. It is an airway. Do not put anything in the mouth. Do not throw water. Stay until 192. If they stop breathing, turn them onto the back on a hard surface and start the chest.

03 Someone who is not breathing They do not answer. The chest does not rise. A rare snore is not breathing. Call 192. Center of the chest, between the nipples, a hard surface. Adult: two hands, five to six centimeters, one hundred to one hundred and twenty a minute. Child: one hand, less deep. Baby: two fingers, about four centimeters, without pressing the belly. If you took a course and remember, thirty compressions and two breaths. If you do not remember, hands only. Stop when help takes over, the person truly breathes, or you cannot go on. Switch person every two minutes if someone is there.

04 Choking A strong cough: let them cough. Cannot speak, cannot cough, hands at the throat: ask if they are choking. If they nod, lean them forward. Five blows between the shoulder blades. Five thrusts inward and upward, above the navel. Repeat. Late pregnancy or a very large person: the chest, not the belly. Baby: face down on your forearm, head lower, five blows on the back, turn, five thrusts with two fingers on the chest. Do not sweep a finger in blind. If they faint, lay them down and compress. 192 should already be on the line.

05 Blood Direct pressure with a clean cloth. The hand on top. Do not keep lifting it to look. If it soaks through, another cloth on the first. Lay them down. An object stuck in is not pulled: press at the sides. A tourniquet is not the first move. Only when the blood jets and pressure is not holding the life, or 192 tells you. Write the time. Do not loosen it later on your own.

06 Stroke and heart attack, so you recognize them Stroke: mouth pulled aside, an arm that will not rise, speech that will not come, confusion from one hour to the next. One sign is enough. Write the time. Do not give water or aspirin. 192. Heart attack: tightness in the chest, cold sweat, shortness of breath, nausea. In a woman, an older person, and someone with diabetes the pain can be only a sickness that will not settle. Sit them reclined. Do not drive in the middle of strong pain. Medicine only if 192 says so and the person swallows while awake. If they stop breathing, the chest.

07 What the lesson does not let you invent Fainting: lay them down, legs raised if the head was not hit. Do not throw water. Do not use smelling salts. Burn: cool running water for twenty minutes. No ice, no paste, do not burst a blister. Bone: do not put it back. Snake: do not cut, do not suck, do not tourniquet. 192 at once. The full step for each is on the red tab. Study there after this lesson. Do not film instead of calling.

08 How to rehearse without hurting anyone Real compressions only on a course manikin. On a pillow, at home, you train the place of the hand and the rhythm, without the weight that breaks a rib. Choking: rehearse the question and the five blows in the air, without pressing the belly of someone who is fine. Recovery position: once, slowly, on someone who agreed. Stroke: ask them to smile, lift both arms, repeat a sentence. It is a one-minute game. The number 192 stays on the refrigerator, written, not as a link. Once a month is enough so the hand does not debut in the fright. The in-person course stays mandatory. The lesson only keeps the first time from being the only time.
